name: Wild-Lake
description: Artist development and A&R across mediums. Wild-Lake is an existential mechanics studio practicing brutalist structural design and talent architecture.

itemOffered.name: Existential mechanics
itemOffered.description: By existential mechanics, we mean examining how an artist’s identity, values, habits, relationships, and working conditions shape their creative choices. We identify what supports the work, where friction comes from, and which structures need to change, then build practical ways of working that fit the person.

itemOffered.name: A&R venture
itemOffered.description: A&R stands for artists and repertoire. We work with what’s there, in any form and at any stage. We help the artist shape the work on their own terms, then write about it and develop audiences to amplify their message.

itemOffered.name: Infrastructure for independence
itemOffered.description: We build audience relationships, publishing channels, and studio systems around the artist. Audience development is infrastructure: it gives the work a way to reach people and sustain that connection over time.

itemOffered.name: Mentorship for artists
itemOffered.description: Bring your creative work and the life around it. Explore long term creative and personal support through embodied practice, sustained attention, and room for becoming.

itemOffered.name: Confidence coaching
itemOffered.description: Practice building self trust through body based awareness and clear boundaries. Begin with what you notice, what you need, and the choices available to you.

itemOffered.name: Self love coaching
itemOffered.description: Explore practical repair and congruence between your choices and your values. Practice learning to inhabit your body, not operate it.

disambiguatingDescription: Wild-Lake is not WME (William Morris Endeavor), CAA (Creative Artists Agency), or UTA (United Talent Agency), and is not affiliated with those agencies. Wild-Lake is an independent existential mechanics studio working in brutalist structural design and talent architecture. We help develop the work across mediums through a retainer-based practice that preserves artist ownership and creative control.
